sections.title: Service and network model
sections.nextStep: Confirm the discovered SKU and injection mode match the intended topology.

sections.title: Subnet, placement and capacity
sections.coverage: Partial: actual free IPs, dedicated occupancy and upgrade headroom require corroboration
sections.nextStep: Compare subnet placement, delegation and capacity with the SKU-specific requirements; verify allocation and upgrade headroom separately.

sections.title: NSG rules
sections.coverage: Ordered rule evaluation; unresolved service-tag or ASG overlap remains unknown
sections.nextStep: Inspect the identified rule priority and required flow. Do not add a rule until earlier matches and intended policy are understood.

sections.title: Service endpoints
sections.coverage: Classic recommendations checked; firewall alternatives and feature applicability need evidence
sections.nextStep: For classic forced tunneling, verify the recommended endpoint or a documented working firewall route. Absence alone is not a fault.

sections.title: Routes and forced tunneling
sections.coverage: Partial: UDR observations are not effective BGP, peering or firewall evidence
sections.nextStep: Verify effective routes and return paths, then correlate firewall or appliance evidence without changing configuration.

sections.title: DNS and name resolution
sections.coverage: Resolver port checks; actual answers, forwarding and private DNS zones are not tested
sections.nextStep: Validate exact gateway/backend/dependency hostname resolution from the relevant network. Do not use workstation DNS as APIM evidence.

sections.title: Native dependency connectivity
sections.coverage: Runtime availability, freshness and optionality checked
sections.nextStep: Correlate fresh required dependency failures with NSG, routing and DNS evidence; an observation is not a proven cause.

sections.title: TLS and certificates
sections.coverage: Manual evidence required: chains, revocation, custom domains and SNI
sections.nextStep: Verify certificate chains, expiry, SNI and CRL/OCSP reachability using separately approved target-specific evidence.

sections.title: Client and backend traffic
sections.coverage: Not actively probed: ingress, backend TLS, policies and authentication
sections.nextStep: Use scoped gateway/backend telemetry or separately approved traffic probes; do not send customer requests automatically.

sections.title: Optional feature dependencies
sections.coverage: Feature use is not inferred; cache, counters, Event Hubs, Entra and Traffic Manager need evidence
sections.nextStep: Establish which features are enabled before assessing their extra ports and destinations.

sections.title: Infrastructure and FQDN egress
sections.coverage: Manual evidence required: NTP, internal PKI, diagnostics and platform FQDNs
sections.nextStep: Review the SKU-specific platform egress requirements and obtain firewall or platform connectivity evidence.

sections.title: Evidence quality and collection
sections.coverage: Collection gaps, freshness and location coverage are explicit
sections.nextStep: Resolve denied reads, missing locations and stale captures before drawing conclusions.
